title: Eden Hotel engagement and Berlin recordings with Polo and Bowlly
summary: After six months at the Barbarina he played the Eden Hotel and recorded with the same band augmented by Danny Polo and Al Bowlly.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: And there was no problem. I stayed after my six months at the Barberina. I had an engagement at the Eden Hotel, for another Mr. Lehmann, and that was another six months.
Well, this was the same band that you recorded with?
Yes, that was the same band, augmented.
Oh, augmented, you had to add players to the recordings?
Oh, yes. That's where I added on certain recordings I had Danny Polo with me.
And Al Bowly, you've heard of?
Well, he's on the record [Arthur Briggs in Berlin: 14 rare recordings from 1927, Black Jack Lp 3006].
Well, let me get that straight then. So, Danny Polo and Al Bowlly worked in your band?
